entities.summary: Adam Ołdakowski is a Polish politician. He was elected to Sejm on 25 September 2005, getting 7488 votes in 34 Elbląg district as a candidate from the Samoobrona Rzeczpospolitej Polskiej list. He was also a member of Sejm 2001-2005.
